value.text: Run fast times in the big outdoor meets. That's the route.
Three or four races a season? You need twelve at least.
Indoor meets for ranking points? That won't get you to Paris.

messages.source: Written for the story, not verbatim quotes (Maarten, 21 Sept 2026: no actual messages exist). Grounded in docs/john_heymans_olympic_journey_ai_strategy.md (supplied by Maarten, 21 Sept 2026): the conventional advice was 12 to 15 high-profile outdoor races chasing fast times; John raced three or four indoor meets for placing points, against his federation, coach and competitors (CLAUDE.md).
